Supercharge your snack time with Ziggy – a beloved, brainy companion jam packed with unique facts ready to melt your mind!


Munch on over 100 delicious and funky factoids through the magic of your Yoto player. Whenever you're ready for another fact to elevate your trivia game, just press the button and Ziggy will deliver your next nugget of wisdom.


What’s the closest living relative to the Tyrannosaurus rex? Or maybe you’re wondering what the national animal of Scotland is? Did people say “cheese!” before their picture was taken in the Victorian Era? Listen to uncover the answers, and much more!


PLEASE NOTE: This card requires a Yoto player or Yoto Mini to experience the interactive randomisation of the responses as designed.

seo.description: Yoto Says: Boost your brain power! With over 100 wonderfully weird and totally random facts, what will wow you today? Supercharge your snack time with Ziggy – a beloved, brainy companion jam packed with unique facts ready to melt your mind!Munch on over 100 delicious and funky factoids through the magic of your Yoto player. Whenever you're ready for another fact to elevate your trivia game, just press the button and Ziggy will deliver your next nugget of wisdom.What’s the closest living relative to the Tyrannosaurus rex? Or maybe you’re wondering what the national animal of Scotland is? Did people say “cheese!” before their picture was taken in the Victorian Era? Listen to uncover the answers, and much more!PLEASE NOTE: This card requires a Yoto player or Yoto Mini to experience the interactive randomisation of the responses as designed. Supercharge your snack time with Ziggy – a beloved, brainy companion jam packed with unique facts ready to melt your mind!


Munch on over 100 delicious and funky factoids through the magic of your Yoto player. Whenever you're ready for another fact to elevate your trivia game, just press the button and Ziggy will deliver your next nugget of wisdom.


What’s the closest living relative to the Tyrannosaurus rex? Or maybe you’re wondering what the national animal of Scotland is? Did people say “cheese!” before their picture was taken in the Victorian Era? Listen to uncover the answers, and much more!


PLEASE NOTE: This card requires a Yoto player or Yoto Mini to experience the interactive randomisation of the responses as designed.
